lines: Decision needed from Brandon, unchanged, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end. He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread. The Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

Chain 27 is read whole and on origin main (`e5671c9c`, pushed 10:01 UTC): summer's stone, summer's glass fifth list and summer's air. On it: tsc exit 0, make base-summer exit 0, build exit 0, engine `45ab169597ec2ed4`; "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.875" (base 0.875, miniature 0.905; chain 26 read 0.8026, 0.803 and 0.888); M4 0.9694, 0.8951, 0.956, 0.9584 and M5 0.993, 1, 0.9757, 0.9995, all pass and equal to chain 26's; two of the eight draft stills moved, summer's, the six others equal; the whole vitest 68 files passed and 1 skipped, 952 tests passed and 4 skipped; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass; triangles at high winter 1,490,555, spring 1,496,825, summer 1,703,094, fall 1,796,373 of 1,800,000.

That head carries one open fault, found by summer's air builder in its own push after I had merged it: at the close camera each of summer's out of focus lights was drawn as a bunch of eight dots. Decision 185: the chain went to origin as read, the fault is logged as open on that head, no publish and no film frame is taken from it, and from now on a part is merged after its builder's report is read, not on its push alone. The mend is pushed (`agent/p6-summer-air` `24b901a1`, one number, held by a test); picture 3 shows it. It goes into chain 28.

Decision 186: the base's height stays 33 mm for all four seasons and my aim for a lower spring body is withdrawn. Decision 40 set 33 as the lowest value that keeps the glass at its approved size in the frame with one seat for four seasons, and winter was refused a lower base earlier. So every base stands about 2 to 5 mm taller than its approved picture shows. It stays listed for the review.

The sixth publish. The helper machine drew the 40 first pictures on `3170155e` in 13.8 minutes and pushed them (`agent/p6-first-6` `3d6065fc`, "poster: pass", engine `85cf73c2c01e9f16`). The fresh security reviewer read that commit: "BLOCKS: no", no block and no warning, 0 vulnerabilities in 141 dependencies, no secret, no request off the page's own address, hostile addresses change nothing. It also said the globe did not draw in its own browser, whose software renderer gave shader errors on every address. I loaded chain 27's build here under the renderer a visitor's Chrome falls back to: no error and no warning in 77 seconds, the controls mounted and the canvas showing (MEASURED here; chain 27's head holds all of `3170155e`). I asked the reviewer for its errors word for word and for the same test on the fifth publish's commit. The publish build runs here since 10:05 UTC. The publish follows when its checks read green and the reviewer's answer names no fault of the page, about 10:35 to 10:45 UTC; I said about 10:30. The live app is still the fifth publish.

Picture 1 is summer at rest on chain 27, the approved picture left and the build right (file time 09:36 UTC, after the chain's start). Picture 2 is summer at the landing on chain 27: the air is one swirl now. Below the bar: its strokes are cream, thick and even, like feathers, and they hide the tree and the cottage, where the approved has wisps, sheets and gaps with the scene ghosted through.
Picture 3 is the fault and its mend at the close camera, four crops, the pushed head above and the mend below: one light where eight dots stood. Not on main yet.

Picture 4 is spring's base, the approved picture above and the first pair of the seventh list below (not pushed). Its builder traced the blue pixels to their cause, the low sun on the growth going far over white with the lens's fringe laying red and blue beside it, and mended it there: deep blue pixels in film frame 1030 from 1,409 to 693 at 3840 and pure white to 0 (STATED). Below the bar: the crest is a rolled rim where the approved is one broad cushion with the glass nested in it, about 20 thin roots where the approved has about 8 thick ones, the moss's lower edge level where the approved's hangs in tongues.

Other reports since Status 207, each on its builder's own pictures and numbers. Summer's stone, a registered pair in its working tree (not pushed): the dark bands are out and its lines now read as drawn on flat ground, so its builder will not push it; its measures overturned two of my words (the approved's left scallop is a mid tan, not cream; the lit sand's light is not short), so I withdrew both and gave the form: each ridge a roll with a lit facet above and a soft shade below, no line anywhere. Summer's glass at 3840: no seam, a smooth rim; below the bar the flame is a flat leaf and the top's bands are soft. My own measure there overturned my eye again: the inside air is not paler than the approved's, so its fill stays. Summer's sand stream (`b576180c`, pushed): single grains with dark between them where a cream veil stood; below the bar it is coarse lace, half the approved's breadth, grains twice as wide; it goes into chain 28 and its eighth list is the broad sheet in front of the stone's flank. Fall's air merged with summer's air (`4e8b1336`), proved both ways by hashes; its eighth list starts from counts (the approved has about 38 leaves in the upper left quarter, eight of them 20 px or longer; ours about 30, none over 17 px). Fall's base eleventh step (`fc68c28f`, pushed) is held: the lit wall at the right reads as an even pale sheet where the approved is black wet rock in lumps and folds; ruled as form for the twelfth. Summer's miniature sixth list is pushed (`e5fc7e1e`), its report follows about 10:25 UTC. Summer's tree, second pair of the eleventh: the crown is dark cushions now, fuller and rounder than the approved's; ordered apart into pads with limbs showing in the gaps, push 10:25 UTC.

4K motion: chunk 58 of film B draws at 3840 until about 10:20 UTC, then the test of the wider bell, numbers by 11:00 UTC. Not a pass. The change of season: push about 11:00 UTC, not merged. Controls: not a pass; nothing has been seen on a real card at 60 a second.

Below the bar, plainly. Summer: the crown too full and round, the base reads as grey weathered wood where the approved is pale packed sand, seeds as cream stars of few spokes, lights as even dots, the glass's flame and top bands, the landing's feathers, the sand stream. Fall: the air's points pale and hard, leaves of one shape and size, the roof, wall, fence and path as forms, the stone wall, no lights on the boughs. Spring: the crest, the roots, the moss's edge, the lit moss at 3840. The change of season, 4K motion and the controls as above.
Next: the sixth publish, then chain 28 with summer's air mend, fall's air and summer's sand stream; Round 23 on summer when its lists are in.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 27's two M3 stills, eight draft stills, counts and the whole vitest, and one page load under the fallback renderer. On helper machines: the 40 first pictures, the builders' own stills, and chunk 58 at 3840 in work. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
